meta.vintageNote: The workbook does not publish a data revision timestamp. Source version parameters and capture dates do not establish revision dates.
meta.note:
Notes:
1. For subscriber count provided on or before Feb-2024, the data is given as per the subscriber association of Feb-2024.
2. The subscriber count for the month Feb-2024 onwards is as per the association of the given month. Separate metrics and association rulers: historical months before February 2024 use the fixed February 2024 association; February 2024 onward uses the given month association. Both source clauses agree at the boundary month.
meta.sourceConflictNote: Exact source values retained; 25 cells carry sourceConflicts. Do not derive participant/cohort rates or silently reconcile published totals.
meta.categoryApplicabilityNote: NON-IRA is retained as a compliance/unclassified source category, not an age band. Total is an overlapping aggregate, not another age cohort. Vatsalya rows under shared age/gender headers have unresolved demographic applicability; no child age/gender distribution, guardian definition or participation rate is inferred.
